* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope (Errata 2)]]): PNG published in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4 commit 44c7bc5c], authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z.
